what: Waste treated by the plant a year
source: WasteServ, ECOHIVE news, 'Malta's Waste-to-Energy Project Procurement Reaches its Final Stage', 26 Jun 2023
note: The claim: 'This plant will be treating around 192,000 tonnes of non-recyclable waste generated locally ...'. Same figure in WasteServ releases of 31 Jul 2023 and 13 Oct 2023 and on the ECOHIVE project page ('With a capacity of 192,000 tonnes annually').

what: Share of 'Malta's total energy needs' the plant is expected to meet
note: The claim: 'It is expected to meet around 4.5% of Malta's total energy needs.' Earlier wording, 23 Oct 2020 and 2 Nov 2020: 'adding an impressive 4.5% as green energy to Malta's total energy demand'. No method or denominator published.

what: Electricity the plant will send to the grid a year
source: WasteServ, ECOHIVE project page (undated; read 10 Oct 2026)
note: 'Indeed, the plant will generate 126GWh annually to the grid.' Maltese version: 'madwar 126GWh f'elettriku kull sena' (about 126 GWh of electricity a year).

source: WasteServ, ECOHIVE project page (undated; read 10 Oct 2026)
note: '... this facility will be treating 40% of non-recyclable waste generated in Malta diverting it away from landfill disposal.' Same page gives the 192,000 t capacity.
